Enough dmg such that your *AURA* can ALWAYS 1 shot the oranges at OJ bay.

Auspicious Aura: 200+
Raise Dead:  181 (158)

Cranium Cooking: 226 (205) (1)

Go to OJ Bay (Either no weapon or boxing gloves)
Your skills (excluding Cranium cooking) should be ordered the exact same way as shown in the Picture. 
Hit Auto
